title: Twin Unity
next_chapter_hook: When the gears of destiny re-engage, the final page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolds, and Chen Ji will face the ultimate truth beyond Heavenly Dao—and all of this is merely another chess game of the Heavenly Dao.

text.content: At the moment the Tianji Record violently unfurled, the entire Void trembled. On that yellowed fragment, four rays of light broke free like caged dragons shattering their chains, surging toward the heavens. Countless ancient runes surged forth like a flood, weaving threads of destiny before Chen Ji—each thread connecting to the lives and deaths of all beings, each ray reflecting the joys and sorrows of the cycle of Heavenly Dao. And at the deepest part of that radiance, two silhouettes slowly condensed. One belonged to Chen Ji himself, the other... was the old man in cyan robes, Ling Yuan. Their gazes collided in the Void, without hatred, without rage—only a serenity beyond emotion, the composure of an observer facing destiny.

「Chen Ji... no, perhaps I should address you as 'Same Origin.'」 Ling Yuan's voice was no longer aged and hoarse, but had become identical to Chen Ji's, yet carrying the unique authority of destiny, 「Did you think you came this far through your own scheming? Wrong. This is the will of the Tianji Record, the arrangement of destiny. You and I were originally one. The Tianji Record split into two possibilities in the river of time—one is you, passionate yet foolish; the other is me, cold yet correct. Now, it is time to end this division.」

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood there quietly, his gaze sweeping across the threads of destiny that bound himself and Ling Yuan—those threads tightly connecting them, like the umbilical cord of twins. A cold smile slowly curved at the corner of his mouth. 「One?」 His voice was terrifyingly calm, 「Are you certain it is me unified with you, rather than you parasitizing upon me?」 Ling Yuan's eyes slightly narrowed.

text.content: 「You were chosen by the Tianji Record, yet not devoured by it—do you know what this means?」 Chen Ji stepped forward, and the qi around him began to flow, 「It means you are merely a failed defective. The true inheritor of the Tianji Record, from ancient times to now, has only ever been one—」 He raised his right hand, and the four rays of light gathered in his palm into a dazzling sword edge. 「Me.」

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression finally changed. A ferocious smile appeared on that face so similar to Chen Ji's. 「Bold! Truly the inheritor that foolish Chen Xuan would choose.」 His voice sharply rose, and the threads of destiny around him writhed like mad serpents, 「Do you think your current power can oppose mine? Your Heavenly Fate has been exhausted, your body is on the verge of collapse—」 He猛地 pointed at Chen Ji: 「You are merely pretending!」

text.content: Chen Ji did not refute. He merely lowered his head, gazing at his hands covered in cracks—each crack was the price of using the Tianji Record, every drop of refined blood was interest for peering into Heavenly Secrets. He truly was at the edge of collapse. But his eyes remained serene, even carrying a hint of relief. 「You are right.」 He raised his head, his gaze like a blade, 「So, I give you a choice.」

「Choice?」 Ling Yuan coldly laughed, 「The plea of the defeated?」 「No.」 Chen Ji's voice was calm as a verdict, 「It is a gift.」 He slowly raised his hand, and the four rays of light wove behind him into a scroll of destiny. Within that scroll, three endings slowly manifested— Reconciliation: The twins separate, each existing independently. Fusion: The twins unify, becoming a new observer. Mutual Death:玉石俱焚, leaving behind a tragic legend. 「Destiny has given us three endings.」 Chen Ji's voice echoed in the Void, 「Choose one.」

choice.prompt: At the crossroads of destiny, Chen Ji offers three choices. How do you wish for Chen Ji to respond to this twin confrontation?

choices.description: Reconcile with destiny, exist independently. Preserve the twin bond, but no longer devour each other. This is the wise choice, and also the most difficult path.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon Part of the Tianji Record's Power
choices.visible_reward: Transform the Twin Bond into Protection
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan May Not Willingly Accept

text.content: Chen Ji extends his hand, and a translucent orb of light materializes in his palm—that is a wisp of the Tianji Record's core source.

dialogue.content: 「This wisp of source can allow you to exist independently of me.」 Chen Ji's voice held no波动, 「You will no longer need to parasitize the Tianji Record, no longer need to fear being devoured. Each of us becomes a chess piece, walking our own path.」

choices.description: Fuse with Ling Yuan, becoming one. Gain complete power of destiny observation, but the price is losing the name Chen Ji, becoming a new observer.
choices.visible_reward: Complete Power of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Will Chen Ji Still Be Chen Ji After Fusion?

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. It was a relieved laugh, tinged with self-mockery.

dialogue.content: 「You wish to become complete me?」 He slowly spread his arms, and the four rays of light began flowing between Chen Ji and Ling Yuan, 「Then come. Let's see if your obsession is stronger, or my will is harder.」

choices.description: Die together with Ling Yuan, leaving a tragic legend. Destroy a piece of Heavenly Dao, but also lose everything Chen Ji has.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao May Have Other备用手段

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at those cracked hands. He thought of Chen Nian, of Su Qingyao, of the sister he hadn't yet found.

dialogue.content: 「If I am destined to be devoured by destiny...」 His voice suddenly grew low, 「Then let this destiny perish with me.」

text.content: Ling Yuan froze. He stared at the orb of light in Chen Ji's palm, then at the three scrolls of destiny, and for the first time, uncertainty flickered in his eyes. He had expected a desperate struggle, expected Chen Ji to resist with everything, expected him to use his last breath for mutual destruction. But he never expected... Chen Ji to offer choices so calmly. 「What... what game are you playing?」 For the first time, a hint of uncertainty entered Ling Yuan's voice.

Chen Ji gave no answer. He simply stood there, waiting for Ling Yuan's choice. Time trickled by. The threads of destiny trembled between them, the Tianji Record's light flickering. Finally, Ling Yuan spoke. 「...I choose the second.」 His voice carried unwillingness, 「Fusion. I will become the complete observer, I will see the day Heavenly Dao crumbles.」 A cold smile curved at Chen Ji's lips. 「As you wish.」

The light blazed violently. Four rays surged toward Chen Ji and Ling Yuan simultaneously, completely engulfing their silhouettes. The threads of destiny wound madly, weaving a massive cocoon in the Void. Within that cocoon, two consciousnesses were merging, colliding, fighting. Chen Ji felt Ling Yuan's will flood into his Mental Sea like a tide, carrying three hundred years of obsession, hatred, and... a trace of fear. 「You think you can devour me?」 Ling Yuan's voice echoed in the Mental Sea, 「I have waited three hundred years for this moment!」

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled within the Mental Sea. 「Three hundred years?」 His voice was terrifyingly calm, 「You waited three hundred years, but did you ever reach that moment?」 He fiercely concentrated his consciousness, transforming into a blade within the Mental Sea. 「You have always waited for the Tianji Record to choose you, but it never chose you. You are merely an abandoned defective, a wandering ghost parasitic on the edge of destiny.」 The sword's edge pierced Ling Yuan's consciousness core: 「And I—the true inheritor.」

text.content: The battle in the Mental Sea was gruesome. The two consciousnesses continuously collided, merged, tore. Chen Ji's memories and Ling Yuan's memories permeated each other—Chen Ji saw Ling Yuan's three hundred years of loneliness and obsession, and Ling Yuan also witnessed Chen Ji's一路走来的 scheming and sacrifice. 「So that is how it is...」 Ling Yuan's voice suddenly became complex, 「You too are one swept along by destiny. We... are no different.」 「No.」 Chen Ji's voice was resolute, 「I have never been a chess piece of destiny. I am the Chess Player.」

The light gradually faded. When everything settled into stillness, only one silhouette remained in the Void—Chen Ji's silhouette. But that Chen Ji was entirely different from before. His eyes held more desolation, his aura became profound and unfathomable. He raised his hand, and the threads of destiny flowed obediently at his fingertips, like submissive servants. Ling Yuan's consciousness had been completely fused. But he felt no joy. Because in that moment of fusion, he saw the deepest fear in Ling Yuan's memories— The Eye of Heavenly Dao never disappeared.

dialogue.content: An invisible gaze once again fell upon Chen Ji. That gaze was ice-cold, detached yet carrying a hint of amusement, like a supreme deity looking down upon ants. 「Interesting.」 A voice beyond sound rang in Chen Ji's mind, 「You have finally completed the first step.」 Chen Ji猛地 raised his head, seeing nothing. But he knew that voice came from the Eye of Heavenly Dao—from that existence beyond everything. 「The chess game... has just begun.」

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. After the fusion, his perception had grown more than tenfold. He could see the trajectory of destiny's threads, feel the pulse of the Tianji Record's core, even glimpse a corner of the river of time. But he could also feel the weight of that gaze—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had always been there, never leaving. 「Ling Yuan...」 he murmured, 「So you always lived under its shadow.」 He opened his eyes, and determination filled his gaze. 「But I will not repeat your fate.」

The Tianji Record's light surged again, slowly condensing before Chen Ji into a line of ancient characters: 'Twin Unity Achieved, Destiny Remolded. Eye of Heavenly Dao, Do Not Gaze Directly. To Shatter the Heavens, First Gather Nine Pulse.' Chen Ji stared at those characters, a cold smile curling his lips. 「Nine Pulse... so there is such a limitation.」 He raised his hand, storing the Tianji Record into his Mental Sea. After the fusion, the Tianji Record had become completely one with him, inseparable. 「Very well.」 His voice was calm yet resolute, 「Since Heavenly Dao wishes to play, I will play this game to the end.」

The Void began to collapse. The aftermath of the completed fusion started to dissipate, and the threads of destiny beneath Chen Ji's feet gradually turned to nothingness. He felt a repulsive force pushing him out of this space. But before departing, he cast one final glance into the depths of the Void—where the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze still lingered, like an invisible eye watching his every move. 「Watching me?」 he said softly, 「Then watch closely.」 Light flickered, and Chen Ji's silhouette vanished from the Void. And in the deepest reaches of the Void, that gaze still had not moved away. If anything... it seemed to hold even more interest.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he had returned to the mortal world. Around him was ruins—the site of the former Tianqing Sect, once glorious now turned to dust. But Chen Ji had no time for grief, because he sensed three familiar auras rapidly approaching. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and... Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The third aura was Chen Nian. That long-missing sister was now nearby.

「Brother!」 A clear voice rang out from the distance, trembling with disbelief. Chen Ji turned and saw a young girl's silhouette running out from the ruins. Her features were seventy percent similar to his own, but with more fragility and stubbornness. Chen Nian. The sister he had searched for years was now before him. 「You... you're still alive...」 Chen Nian's eyes reddened, tears spilling forth, 「I thought... I thought you had...」 Chen Ji gazed at that face so similar to his own, and an indescribable emotion surged in his heart.
